confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge of Nice and the French Riviera, not checked against live menus, listings, or booking pages. Restaurant and café anchors are moderately reliable. Hotel and hostel anchors are less certain because July is peak season and rates vary widely by district and availability. Cocktail and wine are estimated from typical French Riviera bar and restaurant pricing relative to beer. The FX observation was taken from a search result that cited the RBA statistics page for 16 October 2026; the RBA page itself was not opened directly, so the figure should be confirmed against it.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on the French Riviera and comparable mid-to-large Mediterranean French tourist cities (for example Cannes, Antibes, and Marseille), with a July peak-season premium applied to accommodation and hospitality prices.
